actions: OPEN INPUT CONTROL-FILE ACCT-IN ACCR-IN OUTPUT TRAN-OUT REPORT-OUT
MOVE 'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is not `ALL '0'`, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `ACCR-IN` for input and `TRAN-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; displays `'MONCHG: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-FILE-STATUSES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `ACCR-IN` for input and `TRAN-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-FILE`, `ACCT-IN`, and `ACCR-IN` for input and `TRAN-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-BUSINESS-DATE` to `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`; sets `TRAN-RECORD` to spaces; and performs `1200-READ-ACCOUNT`.

conditions: MASTER-AT-END OR ACCRUALS-AT-END OR AC-ACCT-NO NOT = AM-ACCT-NO
actions: MOVE 'ACCRUALS OUT OF STEP WITH THE MASTER' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When reading `ACCT-IN` finds no more records; reading `ACCR-IN` finds no more records; and `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`) and `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`ACCRUALS-AT-END`), it reads `ACCT-IN`, sets `WS-MASTER-END-SW` to `MASTER-AT-END`, reads `ACCR-IN`, and sets `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` to `ACCRUALS-AT-END`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds no more records; reading `ACCR-IN` finds a record; and `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`) and `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`ACCRUALS-AT-END`), it reads `ACCT-IN`, sets `WS-MASTER-END-SW` to `MASTER-AT-END`, and reads `ACCR-IN`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds no more records; reading `ACCR-IN` finds a record; `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `MASTER-AT-END`) or `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `ACCRUALS-AT-END`); and `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`), `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`ACCRUALS-AT-END`), or `AC-ACCT-NO` is not `AM-ACCT-NO`, it reads `ACCT-IN`, sets `WS-MASTER-END-SW` to `MASTER-AT-END`, reads `ACCR-IN`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'ACCRUALS OUT OF STEP WITH THE MASTER'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record; reading `ACCR-IN` finds no more records; and `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`) and `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`ACCRUALS-AT-END`), it reads `ACCT-IN`, reads `ACCR-IN`, and sets `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` to `ACCRUALS-AT-END`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record; reading `ACCR-IN` finds no more records; `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `MASTER-AT-END`) or `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `ACCRUALS-AT-END`); and `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`), `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`ACCRUALS-AT-END`), or `AC-ACCT-NO` is not `AM-ACCT-NO`, it reads `ACCT-IN`, reads `ACCR-IN`, sets `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` to `ACCRUALS-AT-END`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'ACCRUALS OUT OF STEP WITH THE MASTER'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record; reading `ACCR-IN` finds a record; `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `MASTER-AT-END`) or `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `ACCRUALS-AT-END`); and `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`MASTER-AT-END`), `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is `'Y'` (`ACCRUALS-AT-END`), or `AC-ACCT-NO` is not `AM-ACCT-NO`, it reads `ACCT-IN`, reads `ACCR-IN`, sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'ACCRUALS OUT OF STEP WITH THE MASTER'`, and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When reading `ACCT-IN` finds a record; reading `ACCR-IN` finds a record; `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `MASTER-AT-END`) or `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `ACCRUALS-AT-END`); and `WS-MASTER-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `MASTER-AT-END`), `WS-ACCRUAL-END-SW` is not `'Y'` (not `ACCRUALS-AT-END`), and `AC-ACCT-NO` is `AM-ACCT-NO`, it reads `ACCT-IN` and reads `ACCR-IN`.

When `AC-DUE-MONTH` is not 0, it sets `WS-CLOSED-MONTH` to `AC-DUE-MONTH`, sets `WS-TI-YYMM` to `WS-CM-YYMM`, performs `2100-SETTLE-INTEREST`, performs `2200-CHARGE-FEE`, and performs `1200-READ-ACCOUNT`.
When `AC-DUE-MONTH` is 0, it performs `1200-READ-ACCOUNT`.

When `AC-DUE` is more than 0, it sets `TD-TRAN-CODE` to `TD-INTEREST`, sets `TD-AMOUNT` to `AC-DUE`, sets `TD-DESCRIPTION` to `'CREDIT INTEREST'`, performs `2900-WRITE-TRAN`, adds 1 to `WS-INTEREST-COUNT`, and adds `TD-AMOUNT` to `WS-INTEREST-TOTAL`.

When `AC-DUE` is at most 0 and `AC-DUE` is less than 0, it sets `TD-TRAN-CODE` to `TD-OVERDRAFT-INTEREST`, computes `TD-AMOUNT` as `0 - AC-DUE`, sets `TD-DESCRIPTION` to `'OVERDRAFT INTEREST'`, performs `2900-WRITE-TRAN`, adds 1 to `WS-OVERDRAFT-COUNT`, and adds `TD-AMOUNT` to `WS-OVERDRAFT-TOTAL`.
When `AC-DUE` is at most 0 and `AC-DUE` is at least 0, it does nothing more.

When `AM-ACCT-TYPE` is `'C'` and `AM-STATUS` is `'O'`; and `AM-BALANCE` is less than `WS-FEE-WAIVER-BALANCE`, it sets `TD-TRAN-CODE` to `TD-MAINTENANCE-FEE`, sets `TD-AMOUNT` to `WS-MAINTENANCE-FEE`, sets `TD-DESCRIPTION` to `'MAINTENANCE FEE'`, performs `2900-WRITE-TRAN`, adds 1 to `WS-FEE-COUNT`, and adds `TD-AMOUNT` to `WS-FEE-TOTAL`.
When `AM-ACCT-TYPE` is `'C'` and `AM-STATUS` is `'O'`; and `AM-BALANCE` is at least `WS-FEE-WAIVER-BALANCE`, it adds 1 to `WS-WAIVED-COUNT`.
When `AM-ACCT-TYPE` is not `'C'` or `AM-STATUS` is not `'O'`, it does nothing more.

rules.sentence: When `WS-CLOSED-MONTH` is 0, it sets `REPORT-LINE` to spaces, builds `REPORT-LINE` from `'MONCHG   MONTH-END CHARGES       BUSINESS DATE '` `WS-BUSINESS-DATE`, writes `REPORT-LINE`, sets `REPORT-LINE` to spaces, writes `REPORT-LINE`, sets `REPORT-LINE` to `'NO MONTH CLOSED'`, and writes `REPORT-LINE`.

When `WS-CLOSED-MONTH` is not 0, it sets `REPORT-LINE` to spaces, builds `REPORT-LINE` from `'MONCHG   MONTH-END CHARGES       BUSINESS DATE '` `WS-BUSINESS-DATE`, writes `REPORT-LINE`, sets `REPORT-LINE` to spaces, writes `REPORT-LINE`, sets `REPORT-LINE` to spaces, builds `REPORT-LINE` from `'MONTH CLOSED                  '` `WS-CLOSED-MONTH`, writes `REPORT-LINE`, sets `REPORT-LINE` to spaces, writes `REPORT-LINE`, sets `WS-RC-LABEL` to `'INTEREST CREDITS'`, sets `WS-RC-VALUE` to `WS-INTEREST-COUNT`, writes `REPORT-LINE` from `WS-REPORT-COUNT-LINE`, sets `WS-RA-LABEL` to `'INTEREST CREDITED'`, sets `WS-RA-VALUE` to `WS-INTEREST-TOTAL`, writes `REPORT-LINE` from `WS-REPORT-AMOUNT-LINE`, sets `WS-RC-LABEL` to `'OVERDRAFT INTEREST CHARGES'`, sets `WS-RC-VALUE` to `WS-OVERDRAFT-COUNT`, writes `REPORT-LINE` from `WS-REPORT-COUNT-LINE`, sets `WS-RA-LABEL` to `'OVERDRAFT INTEREST CHARGED'`, sets `WS-RA-VALUE` to `WS-OVERDRAFT-TOTAL`, writes `REPORT-LINE` from `WS-REPORT-AMOUNT-LINE`, sets `WS-RC-LABEL` to `'MAINTENANCE FEES'`, sets `WS-RC-VALUE` to `WS-FEE-COUNT`, writes `REPORT-LINE` from `WS-REPORT-COUNT-LINE`, sets `WS-RA-LABEL` to `'MAINTENANCE FEES CHARGED'`, sets `WS-RA-VALUE` to `WS-FEE-TOTAL`, writes `REPORT-LINE` from `WS-REPORT-AMOUNT-LINE`, sets `WS-RC-LABEL` to `'MAINTENANCE FEES WAIVED'`, sets `WS-RC-VALUE` to `WS-WAIVED-COUNT`, and writes `REPORT-LINE` from `WS-REPORT-COUNT-LINE`.
